title: PolyBridgeBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Physics-Grounded Bridge Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.21493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models, or MLLMs, perform well at visual understanding and structured generation, yet these capabilities do not establish whether an engineering design will work when executed. Existing benchmarks assess spatial reasoning, structural validity, or physics-grounded construction, but they do not determine whether MLLMs can synthesize complete load-bearing structures and repair them after simulator execution exposes a failure. We introduce PolyBridgeBench, an executable benchmark for multimodal bridge design. A model receives a visual scene and structured engineering constraints and generates a complete node--member--material topology. Deterministic legality checks gate execution in a native dynamic physics simulation. Following an execution failure, the benchmark returns temporal visual evidence from the failed rollout and evaluates repair under a fixed interaction budget. translated_title: PolyBridgeBench：面向基于物理的桥梁设计的多模态大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉理解和结构化生成方面表现出色，但这些能力并不能证明一个工程设计在实际执行时是否可行。现有基准测试评估的是空间推理、结构有效性或基于物理的构建，但它们无法确定MLLM能否合成完整的承重结构，并在模拟器执行暴露出失败之后对其进行修复。我们提出了PolyBridgeBench，一个用于多模态桥梁设计的可执行基准。模型接收一个视觉场景和结构化的工程约束，并生成完整的节点-构件-材料拓扑。确定性的合法性检查作为执行门槛，随后设计在原生动态物理仿真中运行。当执行失败后，该基准会返回失败回放过程中的时序视觉证据，并在固定的交互预算下评估模型的修复能力。对确定性有效性等的独立测量（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: PolyBridgeBench是一个可执行的多模态桥梁设计基准，要求多模态大语言模型根据视觉场景与工程约束生成完整的节点-构件-材料桥梁拓扑，在动态物理仿真中执行验证，并在失败后基于时序视觉证据在固定交互预算内完成修复，从而首次系统评估了MLLM设计与修复真实承重结构的能力。
en_tdlr: PolyBridgeBench is an executable benchmark that requires multimodal LLMs to generate complete node-member-material bridge topologies from visual scenes and structured engineering constraints, verify them in a native dynamic physics simulation, and repair failed designs using temporal visual evidence within a fixed interaction budget.
